message.content: Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city. They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses. The nicely layed out stone walls forming shelters from the weathers yet connect the earth with the stories from every family. They decided to learn the craft of housebuilding with the help of a touch of arcane magic from their self-made staff. They visit city settlements with wonder. They like paved ground and bridges. They admire houses built by families. Stone walls shelter them from weather. Those walls connect earth to stories. Pebble Spring wants to learn housebuilding. Their crafted staff helps them. A touch of arcane magic glows. They study beams of light carefully. They measure beams and count carefully. They sketch roofs for tiny shelters. They plan floors for family hearths. They test stones before each wall. They keep notes in a small book. They ask elders for gentle advice. They practice until the magic settles. They learn patience from patient teachers. They improve slowly over many days. They build a model stone house. The young Leshy finally accepted a small contract from a worried family who needed a new stone house near the old bridge before winter arrived with soft light and steady hope for the mottled spotty finish.
